# Document portal acceptance criteria

| AC ID | Acceptance criterion | FDS |
|-------|----------------------|-----|
| AC-001 | A 50 MB file uploads in under 30 seconds on the reference network. | FDS-001 |
| AC-002 | A bulk upload of 500 files completes and an interrupted one resumes. | FDS-002 |
| AC-003 | A new document is searchable within 60 seconds of upload. | FDS-003 |
| AC-004 | A status filter returns only documents with that status. | FDS-004, FDS-005 |
| AC-005 | The ten most recent versions are listed with author and time. | FDS-006 |
| AC-006 | A user without an identity provider account cannot sign in. | FDS-007 |
| AC-007 | A viewer is refused when trying to edit. | FDS-008 |
| AC-008 | An expired share link returns a not-found page. | FDS-009 |
| AC-009 | A document past retention is archived the next night. | FDS-011 |
| AC-010 | The exported archive contains a checksum file. | FDS-013 |
